description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.38 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.69 Å. Mg is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.10 Å. Co is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.34 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to four Na and one Mg atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Co atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Co atoms.
